Brand Recommendation.Summary: two-SALEM-line-extensions incorporating the RP technology on an 85MM and 100MM FFLT Menthol
Brand Recommendation.Background: Project Rp was initiated in 1985 as a New Brands project which combined R&D's technologies into a product offering smokers a personal as well as a social acceptability benefit.

Potential Advertising Claims: In August, 1988, VANTAGE will be introducing the Rp technology in test market on 2 styles an 85MM and 100MM FFLT NM.
Benefits: Low gas phase elements in mainstream smoke
Low biological activity as-defined by the Ames test
Reduction in the amount of total smoke (burns less tobacco and therefore less total smoke)
